capabilities: Render transparent ghost-text suggestions at the cursor while typing
Send surrounding text (2000 chars before, 500 after the cursor) to an OpenAI-compatible API
Accept suggestions with Tab and dismiss with Esc
Configure API endpoint, model, system prompt, provider routing, and trigger delay
Detect and continue text in Chinese or English
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README says the plugin is 6KB with no dependencies and is 'insight-oriented', able to surface questions, reframes, and reframings rather than only continuations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in inline AI autocomplete, so writers who want Copilot-style suggestions while typing must switch tools or use chat-based AI separately.

relations.evidence: defaults to OpenRouter's Groq provider with throughput-prioritized routing
The default setup routes through OpenRouter to the Groq provider for fast inference
transparent suggestions appear at your cursor, like GitHub Copilot

requires.name: OpenRouter API key (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

summary: Inline AI ghost-text writing completion powered by OpenAI-compatible APIs, with Tab to accept and Esc to dismiss suggestions.
